positions.title: Volunteer Software Engineer
positions.description:
Insight Lane is an open source project to model traffic crash risk on city roads. My role as one of the main contributors to the project included
- Feature engineering and adding new map features 
- Turning a series of manual processes into one unified pipeline
- Adding automated tests
- Troubleshooting data processing issues as we onboarded new cities

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
